tasks.purpose: 比较图书馆借阅数量和类别
tasks.setting:
The bar chart shows the number of items borrowed from a town library in three years. The pie chart shows the proportions of items borrowed by category in the final year. The figures refer to the same library, and the bar chart is measured in thousands of items.

Bar chart: loans (thousand items)
Category       2010  2015  2020
Fiction          15    20    24
Non-fiction      10    15    18
Children's       10    10    12
Other             5     5     6

Pie chart: categories in 2020 (%)
Fiction          40
Non-fiction      30
Children's       20
Other            10
bullets: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
must: 概括两图的主要特征，建立有依据的跨图联系，并核对单位与比较对象。
tasks.model:
The bar chart compares the number of items borrowed from a town library in 2010, 2015 and 2020, while the pie chart breaks down the final year's loans by category.

Overall, the total number of loans increased steadily across the period. Fiction accounted for the largest share in 2020, whereas the category labelled other made up the smallest proportion.

In 2010, the library recorded 40,000 loans. This figure rose to 50,000 in 2015 and then reached 60,000 in 2020. Each five-year interval therefore saw an increase of 10,000 items, and the final total was half as high again as the initial figure.

Of the 60,000 items borrowed in 2020, 40% were fiction and 30% were non-fiction. Children's items represented a further 20%, while the remaining 10% fell into the other category. Fiction and non-fiction together thus accounted for seven tenths of the final year's borrowing. At 40%, fiction alone represented twice the share of children's items and four times that of the other category.

tasks.purpose: 比较公园访客数量和出行方式
tasks.setting:
The bar chart shows the number of visits to a town park in three years. The pie chart gives the shares of visits made using four modes of travel in the final year. Both charts refer to the same park, and visits are measured in thousands.

Bar chart: visits (thousands)
Mode           2012  2016  2020
Walking          12    16    20
Bus               9    12    15
Car               6     8    10
Bicycle           3     4     5

Pie chart: travel modes in 2020 (%)
Walking          40
Bus              30
Car              20
Bicycle          10
bullets: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
must: 概括两图的主要特征，建立有依据的跨图联系，并核对单位与比较对象。
tasks.model:
The bar chart presents the number of visits to a town park in three selected years, and the pie chart shows how visitors travelled there in the last of those years.

Overall, visits rose throughout the period. Walking was the most common way of reaching the park in 2020, while cycling accounted for the smallest share of visits.

There were 30,000 visits in 2012. The total increased by 10,000 to 40,000 in 2016, before rising by the same number again to reach 50,000 in 2020. The increase between the first and last years was therefore 20,000 visits.

In 2020, walking represented 40% of the 50,000 visits, and the bus accounted for a further 30%. Together, these two modes made up 70% of the total. Car travel represented 20%, exactly twice the 10% share recorded for bicycles. The proportion of visits made on foot was consequently four times the proportion made by bicycle. The pie chart describes the distribution of trips in that year rather than changes in the travel modes over time.
